title: One anonymous GET with ~2,000 search words crashes the whole server
root_cause: Unbounded public input (term count and length) fed into a recursively-translated expression tree.
fix: BrowseSearch.Parse keeps at most MaxTerms = 16 tokens and MaxLength = 256 characters (never splitting a surrogate pair); the search box carries maxlength.

title: stars>nan, bpm=infinity, ar<1e999 fail the page with a SQL error
root_cause: Numeric parsing accepted non-finite values that have no SQL literal form.
fix: ParseNumber and ParseLength return a value only when double.IsFinite.

title: After any 401 the token provider throws forever; 401 recovery can never succeed
root_cause: Date arithmetic on a sentinel value (MinValue) that has no room below it.
fix: Compare DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.AddMinutes(1) < _expiresAt (the minute goes on 'now').

title: --max-pages reconciles a partial sweep, marking most of the catalogue Departed
root_cause: The 'only reconcile after a finished sweep' rule was enforced for cancellation but not for --max-pages.
fix: --max-pages now sets stoppedEarly; the job is marked Paused with its cursor and returns before reconciling; --resume continues.

title: Ctrl+C leaves jobs 'Running' forever; Paused is never recorded
root_cause: Cleanup/bookkeeping code honoured the token whose cancellation it existed to record.
fix: MarkAsync no longer takes a token; each job catches OperationCanceledException on its own token and records Paused; the CLI returns exit code 130 with a one-line message.

component: Progress ladder, star bands, badge, Browse chips
title: Attempted/Untouched miscounted; status chips disagree with their own lists
root_cause: A derived count computed by subtracting sets from two independent sources that are not subsets of each other.
fix: ProgressQueryService.Attempted() defines the rung once (a playcount join + NOT EXISTS counting score, correlated on the playcount so SQLite probes only played maps); ladder, bands and chips all use it. Benchmarked at parity with the old query.

title: include_fails=1 lets discarded fails push passes out of the API's 100-row window
root_cause: A request flag whose stated purpose ('so we can count the play') was never implemented, against a hard server-side cap.
fix: Poll passes only (include_fails dropped); the 'passed' flag is still checked defensively; README documents the 100-pass window.

component: Recent-scores poll, score backfill, pace projection
title: Pace and '+N in 30d' inflated by accuracy re-plays of old passes
root_cause: One field used both as display ('the score on show') and as a metric input ('when it was passed').
fix: Backfill dates the row by the earliest qualifying pass; the poll moves the date only on promotion from pre-rank or for an earlier run.

title: An upgraded row keeps the old IsLazer flag
root_cause: Duplicated field-by-field copy blocks.
fix: One Show() helper sets every display field; insert, promotion and upgrade all use it.

title: Systemic failures are skipped map by map and the job reports Completed
root_cause: Skip-and-continue error handling with no circuit breaker; cursor advanced on failures.
fix: MaxConsecutiveErrors = 10 fails the run; only an answered map advances the cursor.

title: Client errors (400/403/422) retried five times with ~30 s of backoff
root_cause: Transient classification by exception type alone.
fix: HttpRequestException { StatusCode: { } code } is transient only for >= 500 or 408.

title: Strong ETag (and PNG cache key) ignore the drawn UPDATED date
root_cause: The fingerprint did not include everything the renderer draws.
fix: BadgeSnapshot.UpdatedOn is part of Fingerprint and is what the renderer prints.

title: Dates formatted in the server culture's calendar (th-TH prints 2569)
root_cause: Interpolated/ToString date formatting without an IFormatProvider.
fix: Both sites format with CultureInfo.InvariantCulture (BadgeSnapshot.UpdatedOn).

title: A missing UserId makes every sync 'complete' having fetched nothing
root_cause: No validation of required options before running jobs that depend on them.
fix: ConfigProblem() checks ClientId/ClientSecret (all API commands) and UserId (playcounts/scores/recent); exit 2 with a message.

title: Unreadable --mode/--limit/--max-pages silently ignored (--mode ctb backfills every mode)
root_cause: TryParse failures defaulted to 'no limit' instead of being reported.
fix: TryFlag<T>() reports unreadable or missing values; counts must be positive integers.

title: --resume on a completed sweep double-counts ItemsDone
root_cause: 'resume requested' and 'something to resume' were conflated.
fix: resuming = resume && job.State != Completed drives the watermark, cursor and reset.

title: page >= 42,949,673 wraps negative and serves page one
root_cause: Unchecked multiplication of an attacker-controlled int.
fix: Page clamped to int.MaxValue / PageSize before the multiply; Browse tests the sign before subtracting.

title: ranked=2019-13 silently means all of 2019
root_cause: Each date part parsed independently with a silent fallback.
fix: At most three parts, each must parse and be in range.

title: PenaliseAsync does not drain the bucket as documented
root_cause: Implementation did not match its own contract.
fix: Acquire whatever the bucket holds, then wait.

title: Rate-limit panel hard-codes '/ 60'
root_cause: Magic number duplicated from configuration.
fix: Budget reads IOptions<OsuApiOptions>.

title: Overlapping loads let an older result overwrite a newer view
root_cause: Async lifecycle methods publishing per-await without a staleness check.
fix: A load counter: results gathered in locals and published only if no newer load started.

title: A 404 or malformed page is taken as the end of the catalogue and reconciled
root_cause: Anomalies treated as natural termination ahead of a destructive step.
fix: 404 throws HttpRequestException(404); wrong shape throws JsonException ('unexpected response shape from the osu! API').

title: Shape guards throw instead of skipping (TryGetProperty on non-objects)
root_cause: Assuming TryGetProperty is total.
fix: Check ValueKind == Object before every TryGetProperty.

title: IPv6 clients get a fresh rate-limit budget per address
root_cause: An IPv6 address treated as a client identity.
fix: ClientAddress.PartitionKey: IPv4 (and v4-mapped IPv6) by address, IPv6 by its /64; both limiters use it.

title: If-None-Match compared verbatim: weak tags, lists and '*' never revalidate
root_cause: A hand-rolled string comparison in place of the framework's typed header parser.
fix: IsNotModified reads GetTypedHeaders().IfNoneMatch and matches "*" or any tag by weak comparison; a malformed value falls through to a 200.

title: Badge responses carry no Content-Security-Policy or nosniff
root_cause: No response hardening on the one public document the app builds from request input.
fix: Every badge response sets Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'none' and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff. Headless Chromium renders both layouts under the policy with no violations.

title: 'sync recent is all you need' leaves maps played without passing counted as Untouched
root_cause: Guidance written for the number `sync recent` moves (Passed) and read as covering every rung.
fix: README section 5 lists the three timers and why playcounts is one of them; the Sync page's recent line says 'new passes'.
tests: Documentation only; checked against RecentScoresJob and ProgressQueryService.Attempted.
